headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 33 points, Naz Reid had 20 of his 29 in the second half and the Minnesota Timberwolves pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat Miami 125-115 on Saturday night and snap the Heat's four-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Edwards and Reid combine for 62, Timberwolves win 125-115 to snap Heat's 4-game winning streak

headlines.description: — Tyrese Maxey scored 36 points, Joel Embiid and VJ Edgecombe each had 26 and the Philadelphia 76ers beat the New York Knicks 130-119 on Saturday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maxey scores 36 points and the 76ers win again in New York, beating the Knicks 130-119

headlines.description: — RJ Barrett scored a season-high 29 points, Brandon Ingram also had 29 and the Toronto Raptors beat the Atlanta Hawks 134-117 on Saturday night in the first of back-to-back meetings between the teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: RJ Barrett scores season-high 29 points as Raptors beat Hawks 134-117

headlines.description: — Miles Bridges had 26 points and 14 rebounds, helping the Charlotte Hornets beat the Chicago Bulls 112-99 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bridges and Miller help the Hornets beat the Bulls 112-99

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Deni Avdija had 29 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, Donovan Clingan added a career-high 24 points along with 12 rebounds and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the San Antonio Spurs 115-110 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deni Avdija has triple-double to power Trail Blazers past Spurs, 115-110

headlines.description: — Anthony Davis had 26 points and 12 rebounds and Max Christie scored 24 points, hitting 4 of 6 3-pointers, as the Mavericks beat the Houston Rockets 110-104 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davis' 26 points and Christie's 24 points lead Mavericks past Rockets 110-104

events.name: Utah Jazz at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — Stephen Curry scored 31 points with six 3-pointers and the Golden State Warriors welcomed back their regulars Saturday to beat the Utah Jazz 123-114 after a 37-point thumping by the Thunder a night earlier playing short-handed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Curry scores 31 points in return from one-game absence with ankle injury, Warriors beat Jazz 123-114

headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown matched his career high with 50 points and the Boston Celtics completed a successful West Coast swing with a 146-115 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaylen Brown ties career high with 50 points in Celtics' 146-115 romp over Clippers
